Thank you for your interest in leetsay.

Pull requests are not accepted for now: all code changes are made in this
repository by the maintainer, so every release can be built and signed from
here. Please describe your fix or idea in an issue instead:

- [Bug report](https://github.com/sudo-csmith/leetsay/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- [Idea or request](https://github.com/sudo-csmith/leetsay/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sudo-csmith/leetsay/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
